title: On the cut polytope
authors: Barahona, Francisco and Mahjoub, Ali Ridha
relevance: Foundational cut-polytope paper for the Barahona–Mahjoub odd-clique facets and switching operation; anchors the cut-form family attribution.

title: The Boolean quadric polytope: Some characteristics, facets and relatives
relevance: Foundational source for the Boolean quadric polytope and Padberg’s distinct clique, cut, and generalized-cut facet families; useful for keeping these separate from cut-polytope odd-clique inequalities.

title: The cut polytope and the Boolean quadric polytope
relevance: Establishes the affine congruence between the cut and Boolean quadric polytopes, which transfers facet and separation questions between the formulations.

title: Cut-Polytopes, Boolean Quadric Polytopes and Nonnegative Quadratic Pseudo-Boolean Functions
authors: Boros, Endre and Hammer, Peter L.
relevance: Relates cut facets to nonnegative quadratic pseudo-Boolean functions and gives large polynomially separable subclasses; this is evidence for tractable subfamilies, not for polynomial separation of Padberg’s or Barahona–Mahjoub’s full families.

title: Binary positive semidefinite matrices and associated integer polytopes
authors: Letchford, Adam N. and Sørensen, Michael M.
relevance: Proves separation reductions linking Boros–Hammer, hypermetric-correlation, rounded-psd, and hypermetric inequalities; records the pre-hardness open status and the equivalences among these families.

title: Complexity results for the gap inequalities for the max-cut problem
authors: Galli, Laura and Kaparis, Konstantinos and Letchford, Adam N.
relevance: States that separation for the remaining cut-polytope classes, including odd-clique inequalities and their switchings, was unknown; identifies odd clique with the Barahona–Mahjoub cut-form family and discusses its IQP formulation.

title: A new separation algorithm for the Boolean quadric and cut polytopes
authors: Letchford, Adam N. and Sørensen, Michael M.
relevance: Gives exact polynomial-time separation for specific subclasses, including odd bicycle-wheel and (2p+1,2)-circulant inequalities and switchings, using covariance and switching maps; it does not separate the full odd-clique family.

title: The Boolean Quadric Polytope
venue: The Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization Problem: Theory, Algorithms, and Applications, Springer, pp. 97–120
relevance: The latest broad status source located before the manuscript: §7.2 lists Padberg families (10)–(13) as unknown but suspected NP-hard, and the remaining cut-polytope families—including Barahona–Mahjoub odd cliques (18) and switchings—as unknown.

title: Generalised 2-circulant inequalities for the max-cut problem
authors: Kaparis, Konstantinos and Letchford, Adam N. and Mourtos, Ioannis
relevance: Provides exact polynomial-time separation for generalized 2-circulant cut facets, a later tractable subclass; it does not resolve separation for all Barahona–Mahjoub odd-clique inequalities.

title: Chvatal-Gomory Rounding of Eigenvector Inequalities for QCQPs
authors: Dey, Santanu S. and Jiang, Nan and Kazachkov, Aleksandr and Lodi, Andrea and Muñoz, Gonzalo
relevance: Post-2022 work whose conic closure result identifies a subfamily with the Boros–Hammer inequalities and whose computational method generates sparse cuts; it makes no exact-separation complexity claim for the full family.
